title: Trying to make the most fancy great visual pipeline 100% done by ai
author: SolideMeinung
selftext:
Hello,

sinde month i am trying in gamedev. Its a hard field but also for graphics design. I try so hard to build up my asset and graphics pipeline and all of it comes together now. 

This image is from the game and it looks so nice and epic. I do have some else target but this is a good working version.

100% ai from the first prompt to all assets to all the shaders and so on. 

We are getting somewhere :3
